title: Crispy Roasted Potatoes Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring crispy roasted potatoes stir-fried with a variety of vegetables. This recipe is quick, easy, and perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes and toss with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the snow peas and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add the roasted potatoes, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic to the skillet or wok. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, or until the potatoes are well coated.
